title: Managed Database: included storage GB per node
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database included storage GB per node is specified by contracted tier. Included database storage per node; GB integer. Additional provisioned database storage; USD per GB-month.

| Contracted tier | Included storage gb per node | Storage rate |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 64 | 0.116 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 128 | 0.116 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 256 | 0.116 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 512 | 0.116 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 1024 | 0.116 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 2048 | 0.116 |

## Hypothetical tier comparison
Hypothetical comparison limited to included storage GB per node: choosing Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore instead of Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore changes this value from 64 to 2048, a difference of 1984. This comparison describes that parameter alone.
